title: Why You Can't Hum With Your Nose Closed 🤐
hook_text: TRY TO HUM WITH YOUR NOSE CLOSED

shots.vo: Pinch your nose, close your mouth, and try to hum. It stops.
shots.prompt: a person pinching their nose with lips pressed shut, puzzled face, bright playful light, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
